posts.body:
Here is the evolution of the plugins i created for a game i am making.
I found alot of plugins do not support Premium sprites like Low's which i bought. So i decided to make some that do. Thanks.
Plugin 1 – Unified Logic: Sprite Shadows (ULSS)
​
Adds
dynamic silhouette shadows
under all characters (player, followers, NPCs).
Auto‑detects sprite format
(RTP, LOW, RTPX, Premium12x8) and scales shadows accordingly.
Supports
opt‑out tags
(<noshadow>) for events.
Includes
LOD (Level of Detail)
: creates shadows only when on‑screen, destroys them after a timeout off‑screen.
Smooth lerp transitions
so shadows glide naturally when direction changes.
Roof clearance
: raises shadows slightly to avoid clipping into tiles like roofs.
Plugin 2 – UnifiedSpriteSystem (USS)
​
Core
movement engine rewrite
with
pixel‑tweened motion
and easing curves.
Diagonal wall‑hugging fallback
: slides along walls instead of getting stuck.
Diagonal speed normalization
: prevents diagonal movement from being faster.
RTP “moonwalk” facing
: keeps cardinal facing while moving diagonally.
Follower polish
:
Animation cadence offsets (followers animate slightly out of sync).
Smooth chase logic when far behind.
Extended sheet detection
: recognizes RTP, LOW, RTPX, Premium formats automatically.
Adds
WASD or Arrow key input modes
(toggleable at runtime with a hotkey).
Integrates
smart A
pathfinding* for mouse/touch clicks:
Supports diagonals.
Includes wall‑sliding logic.
Finds nearest passable tile if the clicked tile is blocked.
Clears stale paths on
map transfer
or when reaching the destination.
This shows my Unified Sprite Expanded Reader aka USER. Showing both Low's Premium sprites and the RTP equivalent side by side. I cant put a video so this is what i can show.Let me know what you think.

posts.author: Echowake
posts.body:
I’ve been building a comprehensive plugin suite for RPG Maker MZ and possibly MV (but i dont own it so cant do testing just code it lol) that unifies movement, pathfinding, sprite handling, shadows, and UI polish into one ecosystem that is not hard-coded. It’s stable, but I’d love outside eyes to stress‑test it beyond my own project. If you’re interested in beta testing, here’s what’s included so far:
UnifiedSpriteSystem v1.5 (Sprites & Movement Core)​
Pixel‑tweened motion for smooth sub‑tile movement (no more “jumping” tile steps).
Wall‑hugging fallback for diagonals (slides along walls instead of getting stuck).
RTP‑style moonwalk option (keeps facing cardinal direction while moving diagonally).
Diagonal speed normalization (prevents faster diagonal movement).
Auto‑detects sprite sheet format (RTP 48×48, LOW 100×100, etc.).
Pattern logic for LOW vs RTP sheets (correct frame indexing).
Follower animation offsets (staggered cadence for polish).
Smoothed follower chase logic (catch‑up if lagging, wall‑hugging if close).
Unified cadence system (different walk/run cadence for RTP vs LOW).
Unified Sprite Bounding
Parameter: BoundingTerrainTag (default 7).
Large sprites overlapping ☆ tiles with this tag are forced to “Above Characters” layer.
Prevents tall sprites (e.g., 100×100) from clipping under canopy/bridge tiles.
Unified Logic – Movement v1.4 (Pathfinding & Input)​
WASD ↔ Arrow key input toggle (default F6).
Smart A* pathfinding with diagonals + wall‑sliding.
Nearest‑reachable fallback if target tile is blocked.
Path overlay visualization (toggle with \ key).
Overlay auto‑clears on transfer, disconnect, or destination reached.
Unified Pathfinding AI for events:
Smarter chase logic (near vs far).
<forced_collision> tag support for through events.
Configurable searchLimit parameter.
Player integration: click‑to‑move with A* path queue.
Gamepad integration:
Detects disconnects, pauses game, shows reconnect window.
Clears overlay/path on disconnect.
Resumes on reconnect or keyboard/mouse input.
Hides mouse cursor when controller is active.
Unified Logic – Sprite Shadows v1.6​
Silhouette shadows for all characters (player, followers, NPCs).
Opt‑out with <noshadow> tag on events.
Shadows adapt to sprite format (RTP, LOW, RTPX, Premium12×8).
USER (Unified Sprite Expanded Reader) integration for auto‑detection.
Directional offsets per format (cardinal + diagonal).
Smooth lerp transitions for shadow movement.
Level of Detail (LOD):
Shadows only created when on‑screen (with padding).
Offscreen TTL cleanup to save performance.
Reuse/destroy logic for efficient memory use.
Roof clearance offset (+3px by default) to prevent clipping into roofs.
And currently working on this..
Unified Logic – UI and Map Movement (ULUM) v3.8​
Crossfade Scene Transitions
Smooth crossfade replaces harsh black fades.
Configurable duration (default 30 frames).
Optional switch control: replace only when a specific switch is ON (or always if set to 0).
Window Fade & Opacity Control
Windows fade in/out smoothly (default 12 frames).
Adjustable gradient opacity (0–255).
Gradient Window Backgrounds
Multiple built‑in color variants (Red→Gold, Blue→Teal, Green→Black, etc.).
Direction options: top→bottom, left→right, diagonals, etc.
Gradient backgrounds auto‑refresh when windows resize or change.
Gradient Text Rendering
Text can use the same gradient theme as windows.
Option to
invert text gradient
vs window gradient.
Halo glow effect for extra readability.
Falls back to native drawText if escape codes are present (so compatibility is preserved).
Sound Effect Enhancements
Suppresses default “Move1” SE globally (no more repetitive step sound).
Supports <EntrySE: name,vol,pitch> and <ExitSE: name,vol,pitch> note‑tags on maps.
Plays custom SE when entering or leaving a map.
Transfer & Fade Integration
Crossfade applies to map transfers as well as scene changes.
Overrides fade type when “Black” fade is requested (if switch condition is met).
Fixed & Polished Behavior
Gradient direction handling corrected for both windows and text.
Proper color math and parameter respect (no ignored settings).
Window background bitmaps recreated cleanly (no leftover artifacts).
Font handling fixed so canvas measures/draws with correct font face.
All four plugins are stable in their current form. Demo builds will be released tomorrow to showcase features in a proof‑of‑concept projects.
If you’d like to help test, please reply here or DM me. I’m especially looking for feedback on controller handling, sprite bounding with large sheets, and UI gradient behavior across different resolutions.

posts.body:
Here is the two demo's there kinda of janky but i got family emergency so let me know what you think. Ill be putting up the full ones on itch.io and patreon in two weeks when i return. Have a great weekend all!
Sprites Demo (USER Diagonal Reader)​
Scope:
Very narrow, only handles
6×4 single‑character sheets
(600×400).
Blocks:
Limited to
2 blocks only
(cardinal walk + diagonal walk).
Row mapping:
4 rows = down, left, right, up.
Input:
Adds diagonal input (1,3,7,9) by combining two keys.
Movement:
Diagonal moves only if passable; no sliding fallback.
Animation:
Uses a _diagAnim flag to switch between cardinal and diagonal blocks.
Followers / cadence / tweening:
Not included
— purely a reader + input handler.
Unified Logic:
Unified Sprite System:
UnifiedSpriteSystem v1.4​
Scope:
Full sprite system overhaul, not just a reader.
Motion:
Pixel‑tweened movement (smooth interpolation between tiles).
Fallback:
Wall‑hugging diagonal fallback (slides along walls if diagonal blocked).
Moonwalk:
RTP “moonwalk” option (face cardinal while moving diagonally).
Diagonal normalization:
Ensures diagonals are treated consistently across logic.
Cadence offsets:
Configurable walk/run cadence for RTP and LOW sheets.
Follower logic:
Smoothed follower chase, with animation offset frames.
Recursion fix:
Safe overrides for patternWidth/Height to avoid infinite loops.
Sheet detection:
Supports both LOW (1200×400) and RTP (144×192) formats. (other formats will come when i own them)
Purpose:
A
governance‑grade baseline
for sprite handling, animation, and follower sync.
Shadow DEMO:
Shadows only for
player + followers
(no events).
Black, flattened silhouettes
(squashed vertically, stretched horizontally).
Inverse offsets
: shadows always cast away from the facing direction.
Smooth lerp transitions
when turning or moving.
Minimal
USER detection
(RTP + LOW only).
No roof clearance, no event support, no LOD, no lighting logic.
Unified Logic: Shadow Sprites
Shadows for
player, followers, and all sprite‑bearing events
(opt‑out with <noshadow>).
Full
USER integration
: supports RTP, RTPX, LOW, Premium12x8 formats.
Semi‑transparent silhouettes
(100% opacity cardinals, 90% diagonals).
LOD system
: offscreen TTL + housekeeping (create/destroy shadows dynamically).
Roof clearance
: global Y‑offset to prevent clipping into roofs.
Directional offset tables
per sprite format for accurate alignment.
Auto‑refresh
: detects map changes, follower count changes, or event changes and refreshes shadows automatically.
Lerp transitions
preserved across all these rules.
Governance namespace alignment
(UL / ULS / ULSS / USER).

Details of the Echomap plugin coming this week!
Cinematic Map Title Cards
​
Transform every map transition into a handcrafted moment. Echomap replaces the default map name window with fully animated, film‑quality title cards that feel alive and intentional.
Two Distinct Visual Moods
​
Royal
— polished, ornate, plaque‑like presentation with gold accents and highlight sweeps
Echo
— mystical, spectral, atmospheric glow with drifting light and soft pulses
Each mood completely changes the personality of your map names.
50 Font Themes + 50 Plate Tints
​
Choose from
Spectrum
(color families) and
Chroma
(white/grey/black) libraries:
Reds, Oranges, Yellows, Greens, Blues, Indigos, Violets
Pearls, Ashes, Graphites, Obsidians, Onyxes Every theme includes multi‑stop gradients, glow colors, and intensity settings.
Dynamic Reveal Animations
​
Bring your map names to life with:
Directional wipes
: Left→Right, Right→Left, Rise, Fall, or Drift
Edge personalities
: Mist, Breeze, Iris, Vortex, Curtain, Clock, Ghost
Slide‑In / Slide‑Out
motion synced to the wipe direction
Reverse Exit
for dramatic departures
Every reveal feels handcrafted and cinematic.
Ambient Motion & Glow
​
Add subtle life to your titles:
Gentle
bounce
animation
Soft
glow pulses
Royal
highlight sweeps
Adjustable
cinematic pacing
Your map names no longer just “appear”—they perform.
Per‑Map Customization
​
Override global settings on any map using simple note‑tags:
Change theme
Change tint
Change mood
Change wipe direction
Change edge style
Enable/disable bounce
Hide the map name entirely
Every location can have its own identity.
Game‑Ready Plugin Commands
​
Control the system during gameplay:
Set Global Font Theme
Show Map Name (with optional theme override)
Hide Map Name
Reset Visited Maps (for first‑entry mode)
Perfect for cutscenes, chapter transitions, and scripted events.
Clean, Modern, Unified Presentation
​
Echomap v1.3 is built to feel like part of a premium JRPG UI:
Smooth gradients
Perceptual color blending
Crisp typography
Consistent spacing and alignment
Zero default RPG Maker UI artifacts
Your game instantly feels more professional.
Designer‑Friendly, Zero Coding Required
​
All features are accessible through:
Plugin parameters
Note‑tags
Plugin commands
No scripting knowledge needed.
